name: FilterBar
purpose: A controlled search and table toolbar with mutually exclusive inline or sidebar filter editing.
description: Choose one editing mode. Panel mode keeps search and table controls in the toolbar and edits facets in the sidebar; removable applied chips appear only while that sidebar is closed. Bar mode uses one compact filter picker and never opens a sidebar. Neither mode exposes unused facet options or saved-filter controls. Search is capped at 500px and shrinks with its container.

props.name: filterMode
props.description: Bar mode edits filters inline; panel mode delegates editing to the sidebar.

props.name: filterPanelOpen
props.description: Applied chips appear only when the filter sidebar is closed.

props.name: selectionActions
props.description: Replaces the normal filter/search row while records are selected.

guidance.overview: A controlled search and table toolbar with mutually exclusive inline or sidebar filter editing.
usage: Use bar mode for inline field/operator/value filtering, or panel mode for an external FilterPanel. Do not mount two competing editors for the same task.
Pass one RecordFilterState through value and onValueChange. Query, time range, chips, and facet changes remain synchronized through the reducer.
selectionActions replaces the normal toolbar row while records are selected. Preserve the existing filter state so the same search returns after clearing selection.
accessibility: In panel mode, the filter toggle exposes the panel relationship and expanded state when panelId is provided.
Applied chips have individually named removal buttons. In panel mode they are hidden while the sidebar is open to avoid duplicating the active controls.
context: Use with record grids; density and column controls affect presentation and do not themselves change the filter result.
